name: Happy Island Fantasy
description:
------------------------------------------------------------------
Game plot

Adventurer "Ron" led an expedition team to investigate the vortex of the perennial storm, and the ship disintegrated in the storm.

After waking up, he found himself drifting to an isolated island.

After waking up, the village chief told him that this was the "Happy Island" and that if he wanted to leave, he would have to wait for the next "Sacrificial Day", so Ron stayed there.

He met several beautiful women here, including the village chief's daughter, a charming widow, a mysterious goddess, a newlywed young woman, and so on.

With the help of these female companions, he successfully solved the secrets of the storm on the island and the ancient treasure.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Game elements

[1] Free movement around the island, follow the player's operation and wander around;

[2] Daily gameplay such as fishing, scavenging, Planting, Cooking, Digging;

[3] Mini-games are interspersed in each story process to entertain players;

[4] Rich dynamic CG animations, every detail is full of dynamics;

------------------------------------------------------------------

Margaret: The daughter of the village chief, full of yearning for the outside world, with long purple hair and a curvy figure.

Sophia: A native girl of Xingfu Village, with yellow hair, gentle personality and thin figure.

                        

Olivia: A widow whose husband died early, a convenience store owner, with big and sexy breasts, a beauty in the hearts of the men in the village.

Ilia: A mysterious goddess who seems to have come here just to give birth to offspring. She is dressed in light blue and looks very sacred.

                                

Lilith: Guardian of ancient treasures, possessor of mysterious enchanting skills, controller of storms.

------------------------------------------------------------------
